# datagecko_stream_sections (Resource)

A stream's About tab: its sections, in order, replaced whole. Destroying it empties the tab. Declare one per stream: two on one stream overwrite each other on every apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One datagecko_stream_sections per stream. Two on one stream overwrite each other on every apply.
resource "datagecko_stream_sections" "revenue" {
  stream_id = datagecko_stream.revenue.id

  section {
    title = "What this is"
    body  = <<-EOT
      Daily revenue per sales channel, pushed nightly from the warehouse.

      Contact: data team.
    EOT
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stream_id` (String) The stream whose list this is. A change replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `section` (Block List) One section; at most 20 per stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--section))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stream id: the import identifier.

<a id="nestedblock--section"></a>
### Nested Schema for `section`

Required:

- `title` (String) At most 128 printable characters.

Optional:

- `body` (String) Markdown, at most 20,000 characters, stored exactly as given: a heredoc's trailing newline is part of it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By the stream's id: the list belongs to the stream.
terraform import datagecko_stream_sections.revenue 4f1c6a3e-...
```
